title: Probability and Sample Spaces
summary: Listing all outcomes, counting favourable ones, complements, and whether games are fair.

ib.note: Theoretical probability with sample spaces is MYP 3 Probability

objectives: I can list all outcomes in a sample space.
I can calculate probabilities of events.
I can use P(not A) = 1 − P(A) and judge whether a game is fair.
misconceptions: All totals of two dice are equally likely.
P(not A) is found by counting again from scratch every time.
A game is fair if both players can win.
